subtitle.hi: आदि शङ्कर · स्वरूपं त्वदीयं न विन्दन्ति देवाः

edition.notes: Collated from Green Message kalika_ashtakam (dhyana 1–3 + stuti 1–8). Traditional fierce iconography retained as in the Sanskrit; meanings are plain-language, not a tantric paddhati. Closing colophon: इति श्रीमच्छङ्कराचार्यविरचितं श्रीकालिकाष्टकं सम्पूर्णम्।

description.hi: महाकाली का ध्यान और आठ स्तुति श्लोक — देव भी आपके स्वरूप को नहीं जानते।
description.en: Dhyana of Mahakali and eight verses of praise — even the gods do not know Your true form.
